Steps to Reproduce:

1. Open python file
2. Focus cursor, press enter key (to write newline) or ctrl + s (to save); this sometimes will work the first time (ie. CoPilot will generate some output, albeit fairly slowly -- within a few seconds), but on the second attempt, the IDE generally freezes up.  After a minute or two, VS code displays an alert/error with the message: `"The window terminated unexpectedly (reason: 'oom', code: '-536870904)"` (similar to the screenshot shown [here](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/71614897/vscode-crashed-reason-oom-code-536870904))

I will note a few things:
1. The workspace is on a remote Linux machine, from a Windows desktop.  I actually have two windows computers which I use to connect to this workspace, and the other one does not have an issue running the CoPilot extension.
2. When I disable the CoPilot extension on the Windows desktop, I no longer have any issue.  When I reenable it, any time I try to save a python file or enter a newline, the VSCode IDE freezes up (as mentioned in the reproduction steps above).
